If it does not refresh, the cooldown is not under 15 s, the Energy is below 225, or Aspect of Aftermath rolled too low. Gladiator's Triumph, Azurewrath and the ice ring carry the damage; Enigma is the movement. The author warns the mechanism may be fixed some time. The variant 'desc' notes are copied from the author's Poison Penetrating Shot build and were not read.

d2core/23yt.summary: Poison Imbuement builds: the damage is the poison ticks, not the direct hits. The Sightless set is chosen because it is full of bugs – Sentinel is taken to trigger Concealment's cooldown reduction again and again, Concealment then triggers the set's damage, and spending Energy with the core skill triggers Preparation, which refreshes Shadow Clone's cooldown: a loop. Shadow Clone and Concealment refresh each other and keep Energy up. Penetrating Shot is strong against packs, tap-cast Dance of Knives is the strongest single target. The author names the Pit level of each variant.

maxroll/tornado-druid-guide.summary: Tornado produces enough Spirit for the Storm Shepherd 2-piece; weak early (Rabies for single target). Grizzly Rage kept up by Werewolf ranks, CDR and Calm Before the Storm; Overcharged Aspect for Vulnerable. Push: Berú of the Old Mountain with Stone Burst every 3 s.

thresholds.why: Push: triggers Berú of the Old Mountain
thresholds.quote: Cast Stone Burst every three seconds on groups of enemies to trigger Berú of the Old Mountain.

rotation.step: Tornado toward enemies
Debilitating Roar and Blood Howl whenever available

options.then: Conceited Aspect instead of the Orange Herald
Physical Resistance on charms and gear
Berú of the Old Mountain

maxroll/touch-of-death-spiritborn-guide.title: Touch of Death Endgame Spiritborn
maxroll/touch-of-death-spiritborn-guide.author: kattkills
maxroll/touch-of-death-spiritborn-guide.summary: Rod of Kepeleke gives Touch of Death the Basic tag and removes its Vigor cost; Echo of Kwatli refunds Vigor on Vulnerable hits (Touch of Death: Vulnerable). The Berú of the Multitude 2-piece makes skills Gorilla skills under The Protector; Swarm of Swarms explodes the oldest Swarm for 150%. Ring of Starless Skies' cost reduction enlarges Rod's pool.

core.name: Rod of Kepeleke
core.role: Touch of Death gets the Basic tag and no Vigor cost
core.quote: Rod of Kepeleke gives Touch of Death the Basic skill tag and removes the Vigor cost allowing you to spam it.

rotation.step: The Protector to pull, Knockdown, Resolve
Spam Touch of Death on the clump
Evasive Swipe to the next group

options.when: before an Echo of Kwatli charm
options.then: an Echo of Kwatli amulet

maxroll/trampleslide-druid-guide.title: S15 Landslide Druid Endgame
maxroll/trampleslide-druid-guide.author: dangerstin
maxroll/trampleslide-druid-guide.summary: Landslide: Land Mine for burst on bosses, Cataclysm for AoE – cooldown reduction is essential for Cataclysm uptime (Orange Herald via Hurricane: Derecho, Subo's Thrillseeker). Mjölnic Ryng makes Spirit costs 0 while Cataclysm is up; The Basilisk counters Locran's crit loss; Earth Spike every 4 s keeps max Overpower.

thresholds.quote: Once fully stacked, ensure you're casting it at least once every 4 seconds to maintain maximum Overpower stacks.

rotation.step: Cataclysm – refresh as it comes off cooldown
Spam Landslide on elites and bosses
Trample to break crowd control or move

options.then: a Legendary Amulet instead of Locran's Talisman
Gar instead of Bac + Jah
Debilitating Roar instead of Trample

maxroll/twisting-blades-rogue-guide.title: Twisting Blades Rogue Endgame
maxroll/twisting-blades-rogue-guide.author: Mattias#8502
maxroll/twisting-blades-rogue-guide.summary: Twisting Blades: The Maestro roughly doubles its damage; Blade Shift once refreshes itself. Energy: Tibault's Will via Concealment, 5 Dark Shroud shadows with Mot, resource tempers (Ring of Starless Skies for Cold). Sightless resets Shadow Clone: Sentry for Vulnerable; 86% attack speed is the two-dagger target; Fist of the Iron Rose via Puncture every 8 s.

thresholds.quote: Asheara's Khanjar gets you closer to 86% Attack Speed which is the target when using two daggers.
maintain 5 Dark Shroud shadows with Mot.

thresholds.why: activates Fist of the Iron Rose
thresholds.quote: Fist of the Iron Rose provides a lot of damage and attack speed, and is activated from Puncture once every 8 seconds.

rotation.step: Blade Shift the first enemy – refreshes itself
Shadow Clone: Sentry to Weaken and make Vulnerable
Concealment for Unstoppable and Knockdown

options.then: a resource aspect on a ring
Godslayer Crown; Mythic Leoric's Crown for power
Rustbitten Dirk instead of Sea Lord's Fine Gloves
Jah or Lac instead of Kry

maxroll/tyrants-grasp-warlock-guide.title: Tyrant's Grasp Endgame
maxroll/tyrants-grasp-warlock-guide.author: wudijo
maxroll/tyrants-grasp-warlock-guide.summary: Demonic Grasp spam as an Archfiend skill: Anathema of the Primes makes Tyrant's Grasp cost Wrath instead of Dominance – required at all. Bombardment every 10 s and Rampage on elites add Anathema stacks; Volatility from Sigil of Chaos for Moloch's Beating Flame; Tibault's Will via Metamorphosis/Jah. The set ramps over ~30 s.

core.name: Anathema of the Primes
core.role: Tyrant's Grasp costs Wrath – required for the build to function
core.quote: This is required for the build to function at all

thresholds.quote: Cast Bombardment Endless Barrage once every 10sec for Fathomless and another stack of Anathema of the Primes.

rotation.step: Spam Tyrant's Grasp – slightly outside melee on immovable targets
Bombardment every 10 s
Rampage for mobility, once on elites/bosses
Wall of Agony against elites and bosses

options.then: Rite of the Nameless
3-piece Rite of the Nameless

maxroll/upheaval-barbarian-guide.title: Upheaval Endgame Barbarian
maxroll/upheaval-barbarian-guide.author: beatdropper
maxroll/upheaval-barbarian-guide.summary: Generator-less Overpower Upheaval nukes with Hellhammer and Banished Lord's Talisman; Ring of Red Furor removes the need for crit when 30 Fury is spent per cast; Ramaladni's Magnum Opus with Maximum Fury; Selig doubles Fury (needs Splinter of Anguish to spend 30+). Leoric's Crown only with Insight.

thresholds.quote: Prioritize **30% to 40% Cooldown reduction.**
Aim for **50% to 60%** from Rallying Cry: Booming
Aim for a minimum of **40 Fury per second **from affixes and Insight.
Prioritize **50% to 60% Cooldown reduction.**
Aim for a minimum of **45 Fury per second **from affixes and Insight
Aim for**200 to 300 maximum Fury**.
Aim for**600 to 800 maximum Fury** after equipping Melted Heart of Selig.

thresholds.quote: Ring of Red Furor removes the need for Critical Strike chance if you spend 30 Fury before each cast

Endurant Faith

maxroll/whirlwind-barbarian-guide.title: Whirlwind Endgame Barbarian
maxroll/whirlwind-barbarian-guide.author: aoinomiku
maxroll/whirlwind-barbarian-guide.summary: Spin to win: Gohr's Devastating Grips is the core (groups enemies every 2 s); Ramaladni's Magnum Opus with Maximum Fury (Splinter of Sin avoided); Tibault's Will and Rallying Cry for Fury; Locran's only when Insight covers its −50% crit; Aspect of Anger Management on the amulet. Breakpoints: 60% CDR, 100% crit, 48.8%+ attack speed, 200+ Fury. Selig needs zero life, Tibault's Will and Ring of Starless Skies.

core.role: the core of any Whirlwind build

Iron Skin when Barrier is low or stunned

maxroll/wing-strikes-paladin-guide.title: Wing Strikes Paladin Endgame
maxroll/wing-strikes-paladin-guide.author: R0XY
maxroll/wing-strikes-paladin-guide.summary: Wing Strikes auto-cast while in Arbiter form – no ranks modify it, so Aspect of Tyrael's Jurisdiction (auto-target) and Arbiter aspects carry it. Light's Epiphany 5-piece: +500% Disciple damage only from Arbiter of Justice, which also casts every Ultimate; Condemn every 4 s keeps Arbiter; Aegis off cooldown for 100% Block; Sanctis of Kethamar sky-rockets damage. Wing Strikes has 0% Lucky Hit.

core.role: Wing Strikes auto-targets – without it they may miss
core.quote: Aspect of Tyrael's Jurisdiction - Wing Strikes auto-targets the closest enemies.

Cast Aegis off cooldown to have 100% Block Chance.

Aegis off cooldown – 100% Block
Holy Light Aura off cooldown
Spam Condemn and Rally

Radiant Fire as the secondary set
Endurant Faith instead of an offensive charm

maxroll/withering-fist-spiritborn-guide.title: Withering Fist Endgame Spiritborn
maxroll/withering-fist-spiritborn-guide.author: kattkills
maxroll/withering-fist-spiritborn-guide.summary: Poison Withering Fist with many healing sources and Temerity. Loyalty's Mantle cuts Centipede cooldowns; Aspect of Supremacy via The Devourer (30 stacks need much CDR in single target); Berú of Balazan's Bite 5-piece burst on Scourge. With a +1 slot seal, Sepazontec as a charm and Arioc's Needle – Deadly Strike works with DoTs.

rotation.step: The Devourer on cooldown for Aspect of Supremacy
Payback: Insidious Retribution off cooldown
Spam Withering Fist
Rushing Claw: Evasive Swipe to the next group

options.then: Fer of Slaughter or Phoba of Survival until Balazan's Bite
Sepazontec charm and Arioc's Needle

maxroll/zeal-paladin-guide.title: Zeal
maxroll/zeal-paladin-guide.author: aoinomiku
maxroll/zeal-paladin-guide.summary: Two-handed Zealot: Red Sermon is the core (a big multiplier, Zeal spends life). Aspect of the Zealot's Covenant is a must (one more Fervor stack); Revelator's Aspect with maxed Zealot stacks; Aspect of Interdiction's block enables Aspect of Redirected Force; Rally auto-cast every 6 s by Berú of Dauntless Faith. Crit is naturally high.

maxroll/zenith-paladin-guide.title: Zenith
maxroll/zenith-paladin-guide.author: aoinomiku
maxroll/zenith-paladin-guide.summary: Zenith spam: a decent amount of cooldown and attack speed; ideally Zenith never goes on cooldown – Jah and Falling Star to move.
